Folks —

Legal review notes after quick scan of Priyom's checklist:
- Term language: fine to use explicit dates; include a survivability clause for obligations that extend beyond term (e.g., data retention, audit rights).
- Capacity Exhibit: prefer "Exhibit C (Capacity Schedule)" naming convention (keeps Exhibit B for SOWs). Provide a definition for "capacity unit" in the amendment to avoid billing disputes.
- Billing / PO: we can accept PO numbers and attach PO as an exhibit; Redwood requires invoiced amounts to be unaffected by issuance of a PO (i.e., PO is administrative, not a condition precedent to payment). - Signature authority: GC will be primary signatory. We can provide the SVP-Sales as an alternative signator for amendments <= $250k net ARR only if Legal pre-approves the specific amendment (we will confirm).
- DocuSign: OK — Redwood accepts DocuSign. For accounting, please add a DocuSign envelope checklist item so Finance recognizes the envelope ID.

I can RTFM the amendment Thursday afternoon and return a redline.
